title: TODOs, Stubs, and Placeholders in Implementation
description: Delivering code with TODOs, stubs, placeholder values, or simplified logic to reduce response time. This includes: "// TODO: implement", stub functions that return dummy values, placeholder constants, simplified algorithms that skip edge cases, and partial implementations that leave work for later.
whenToUse: Never. This anti-pattern should never be used under any circumstances.
whenNotToUse: Always avoid. Response time is irrelevant — quality is the only metric that matters.
